readout_other: SEEG spectral power; seizure frequency; interictal epileptiform discharges; post-FUS MRI
direction_notes: Most patients showed increased SEEG band power during sonication followed by decreases after; two patients had fewer seizures within 3 days and one had more subclinical seizures. No consistent relationship with seizure control.
safety_notes: One patient had scalp heating halting treatment after 260 s (completed on repeat after 1 h); one patient had transient naming and memory impairment resolving within 3 weeks; post-FUS MRI showed no lesion or edema.

exposures.label: FUS to the seizure onset zone (SEEG-guided), patient-specific target

device.model: neuronavigation-guided multichannel hemispheric phased array FUS system

timing.protocol_description: Burst-tone low-intensity FUS: PRF 100 Hz, burst length 3 ms, duty cycle 30%, total exposure time 10 min with SEEG recording before, during and after. Patient 2 had two sessions (first stopped at 260 s, repeat 600 s).

source_quotes.n_subjects: Six patients met the eligibility criteria and completed FUS treatment
